answer: Reputation Decay Deposit. An identity’s voting or listing weight starts at zero and rises only through low-value transactions that each leave a public relic: a signed receipt with counterparty acknowledgement. Weight decays exponentially with inactivity, so dormant armies lose influence before they act. A juniper-tagged cohort joining during a gale of new signups must still transact honestly against established agents to climb. Each fake identity therefore costs real counterparty fees and lost deposits, and scaling N sybils multiplies that cost linearly.
